name: Justo José de Urquiza
role: General and first constitutional president of Argentina
contribution: An Argentine general and politician who served as president of the Argentine Confederation from 1854 to 1860.
image_credit: Attributed to Charles DeForest Fredricks · Public domain

checks.lead: Justo José de Urquiza y García (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈxusto xoˈse ðe wɾˈkisa]; October 18, 1801 – April 11, 1870) was an Argentine general and politician who served as president of the Argentine Confederation from 1854 to 1860.
